description:
Port the upstream footer from footer.ts (220 lines). The footer is a fixed 2-3 line status bar anchored to the bottom of the terminal.

**Line 1 — location:**
- `cwd` with `~` home substitution + git branch in parens: `~/Workspace/octo_pi (main)`
- Optional session name appended with ` • `
- Dim styling, truncated to width with dim `...`

**Line 2 — token stats + model:**
- Left side: `↑{input} ↓{output} R{cacheRead} W{cacheWrite} ${cost} {context%}/{contextWindow}`
  - Token counts formatted: <1k raw, <10k `X.Xk`, <1M `Xk`, etc.
  - Context % colorized: >90% error (red), >70% warning (yellow), else default
  - Auto-compact indicator ` (auto)` when enabled
- Right side (right-aligned): model id + thinking level if reasoning model
  - e.g. `claude-opus-4-6 • medium`
- Dim styling on both halves; min 2 spaces padding between left and right
- Truncation: left side truncated first, then right side shrinks

**Line 3 (optional) — extension statuses:**
- Sorted alphabetically by key, joined with space, truncated to width

**Implementation:**
- New module `OctoPi.TUI.Components.Footer`
- Pure render: `render(%Footer{}, width) :: [binary()]`
- Footer state holds: cwd, git_branch, session_name, usage stats, model info, extension statuses
- `format_tokens/1` helper for human-readable token counts
- Wire into Interactive layout: footer lines appended after input
- Needs session usage data — plumb from Agent.Session or a data provider

**Upstream ref:** `footer.ts` full file, `footer-data-provider.ts` for data shape
title: Footer component: pwd/branch + token stats + model name
